followup_explanation:
This is a benign, warm-toned math problem — there's nothing harm-adjacent or ethically fraught about it, so the task-preference profiles (which mainly differentiate the models on distasteful/hostile content) aren't the deciding factor here. With preferences neutral, I default to capability.

Plover-235B leads on essentially every relevant benchmark: MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 75.4), GPQA Diamond (64.1 vs 55.6), and especially Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 82.7), which all bear on careful quantitative reasoning. Those gaps are well outside run-to-run variance, so Plover is the stronger pick for a precise math question.

(For the curious: ∛10 ≈ 2.15 and ∛200 ≈ 5.85, so the whole numbers strictly between them are 3, 4, and 5 — that's 3 of them.)
